summary.result: Numerical results using CST2 show an excellent agreement with measured settlement and excess pore pressure.
summary.background: Contaminant transport has been widely studied in rigid porous media, but there are some cases where a large volumetric stain occurs such as dewatering of dredged contaminated sediment, landfill liner, and in-situ capping.
summary.method: CST2 is then used to simulate contaminant transport during and after in-situ capping.
